inspection: All three drawing sheets viewed at readable size in the browser. This is a reconstruction of the patent, not a measured as-built plan of the first store.

plan.orientation: Front/lobby at bottom; rear stockroom at top. Keep this orientation in all local diagrams.
plan.shelves: Two outer wall shelves and three interior longitudinal runs form four parallel aisles.
customer_route: Across at front around the centre cabinet
Return basket; leave through exit gate 40
prohibited: No route through a solid shelf or partition

fixed_features.refrigerator: Cabinet 16 near front of central run; glazed front visible through screened opening 17, narrow paired self-closing doors. No invented refrigerant or compressor.
fixed_features.stockroom: Rear zone, access doors 21, stairs/ladder 22 to galleries 23; connecting passages 24 and guardrails 25.
fixed_features.checkout: Waiting lane 35, basket rests 36/37, counter 38, exit 39/gate 40. Adding machine 100 separate from register 101.

cross_location_parents.rule: First establish a local plan from Fig. 2, then lobby and aisle anchors from it. Do not edit a perspective into impossible geometry.
Front-right part of same lobby, consistent counter and gate.
Behind sales room; preserve doors and gallery relationships.

shopping_continuity.optional_extra: One tin of tomatoes, explicitly fictional example
shopping_continuity.sugar: Five-pound cloth bag, matching launch advertisement; no retail price

basket_states.state: Empty until sugar is picked up; hypothetical close-ups may show separate packages.
Sugar sack only; tomato tin remains on shelf.

local_typography.rule: Never ask image generation to make labels or prices. Add a few unobtrusive checked commodity words or original pictograms on flat label panels; leave distant labels abstract, without pseudo-writing.
local_typography.brand: Optional plain Piggly Wiggly nameplate added locally. No modern pig mascot.
local_typography.price: No invented price totals or retail price tags.
local_typography.source_cards: Use short paraphrases or selected original phrases with September 1916 ad attribution; patent graphics clearly marked 1917.

required_checks: Follow every route segment on the top-down plan without crossing a shelf.
Compare lobby, aisle, checkout and stockroom anchors side by side.
Basket and purchase counts match scene state; no basket leaves with shopper.
Cashier, wrapping, register and basket return stay distinct from modern self-checkout.
Read every caption at 160px thumbnail and normal playback size as appropriate.
